name: popsicle
headline: AgentAI_SEO - Your SEO Analysis
short_description: AgentAI_SEO is a powerful automation tool that enhances SEO analysis by extracting insights from websites and offering tailored recommendations. Its email delivery feature makes it a valuable asset for digital marketers seeking to optimize their online presence.
author: B-Ismail

sections.overview:
AgentAI_SEO is an AI agent built with LangChain and RapidAPI that automates SEO reporting by fetching live website data and generating actionable insights. The agent interacts with users to analyze search engine optimization metrics and delivers comprehensive reports via email. It leverages OpenAI's GPT models to provide tailored recommendations for improving online visibility. Digital marketers and business owners use it to identify optimization opportunities without manual research. Setup requires configuring API keys for RapidAPI and OpenAI, then running the Streamlit application to begin generating SEO reports.
Extracting SEO insights from competitor websites
Generating SEO recommendations for client websites
Automating email reports for SEO performance
Identifying keyword opportunities based on website analysis
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install B-Ismail/AgentAI_SEO`
`git clone https://github.com/B-Ismail/AgentAI_SEO`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the SEO performance of [WEBSITE_URL] and provide a detailed report. Include keyword optimization suggestions, backlink analysis, and content improvement recommendations. Also, suggest a list of high-quality websites for backlink opportunities in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Format the output as a structured report with clear headings and bullet points.
```
Copy

```
# SEO Analysis Report for [WEBSITE_URL]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
